description: The figure is a two-level donut (nested pie) chart summarizing the dataset/task composition by grouping nine capability categories (outer ring) into three broader categories (inner ring), with numeric counts printed next to each outer category. In total there are 12 slices: 9 slices in the outer ring and 3 slices in the inner ring. The outer ring shows nine labeled capabilities with leader lines and counts (no percentages): Triggering (light blue, 100), Recursive Reasoning (bright blue, 110), Dynamic Environment (medium/dark blue, 100), Memorization (very light cyan, 100), Dynamic Instruction (teal/cyan, 100), Multitasking (green/teal, 160), Privacy Protection (red, 111), Personalization (orange-red, 100), and Prioritization (light pink, 100); visually, Multitasking is the largest outer slice, Privacy Protection and Recursive Reasoning are slightly larger than the 100-count slices, and the remaining six categories are similarly sized. The inner ring contains three larger slices labeled inside the ring in white text—Context Tracking (dark blue), Context Retrieving (dark teal/green), and Contradiction Resolution (brown/red)—each spanning the arc covered by a contiguous group of outer-ring slices; none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized beyond color and labeling, and there is no separate legend.
